اعتكدنا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَكَدْنَا (iʕtakadnā) /iʕ.ta.kad.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# اُعْتُكِدْنَا (uʕtukidnā) /uʕ.tu.kid.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
